notes: 2026 brackets come from the Nebraska DOR 2026 Tax Calculation Schedule marked 'DRAFT AS OF 8/17/2026 DO NOT FILE' and match the official 2026 Form 1040N-ES worksheet; final 2026 forms were not yet released on 2026-10-22.
Under Neb. Rev. Stat. 77-2715.03 the third and fourth brackets both carry 4.55% for 2026 (top rate down from 5.20% in 2025), so they are merged into one 4.55% bracket here.

Standard deduction ($8,850 / $17,700 / $12,950) and the $176-per-exemption personal exemption credit are the 2026 indexed values printed in the official 2026 Form 1040N-ES booklet. MFJ credit = 2 x $176; dependents' exemption credits are not modeled.
Additional standard deduction for age 65+/blind and the reduced standard deduction for dependents are not modeled.
Nebraska itemized deductions (federal itemized less state income taxes) are not modeled.
Credits not modeled: Nebraska earned income credit, child/dependent care credit, property-tax-related credits, credit for tax paid to another state, and others.
Schedule I adjustments (e.g., Social Security and military retirement exclusions, U.S. obligation interest) are not modeled.

seDeduction.note: Nebraska starts from federal AGI (Form 1040N line 5), which already reflects the deductible half of SE tax; Schedule I has no add-back for it.

seHealthInsurance.note: Inherited through federal AGI; Nebraska Schedule I has no add-back for the self-employed health insurance deduction.

retirementContributions.note: SEP/solo 401(k) deductions taken above the line in federal AGI flow through; no Nebraska add-back.

qbi.note: The federal QBI deduction is taken after AGI, so it never reaches Nebraska's federal-AGI starting point.

localIncomeTax.note: Nebraska has no city, county, or school-district income taxes.

estimatedTax.threshold: Nebraska income tax after personal exemption credits expected to exceed withholding and other credits by $500 or more
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: No penalty if payments (incl. withholding) equal at least 90% of the 2026 tax, 100% of the 2025 Nebraska tax (if 2025 federal AGI was $150,000 or less), or 110% of the 2025 tax if 2025 federal AGI was over $150,000; also no penalty if 2026 tax less withholding is under $500. Farmers/ranchers/fishers use 66 2/3%.

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $100 online / $110 in-office for the Certificate of Organization (Nebraska Secretary of State). Nebraska LLCs must also publish a notice of organization in a newspaper (newspaper charges vary) and file the Affidavit/Proof of Publication ($25 online / $30 in-office).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $30 biennial report, due by April 1 of each odd-numbered year (delinquent June 16), per the Secretary of State's LLC biennial fee schedule.
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None for LLCs (Nebraska's biennial occupation tax applies to corporations, not LLCs).
